title: Beacon Ridge Solar Share Savings Guarantee: Annual True-Up
content:
When a Community Solar Subscriptions plan carries the savings guarantee, at each allocation anniversary the fees of the ending allocation year are compared with that year's credits. When the fees exceed the credits multiplied by 100 less the plan's discount percentage, divided by 100, the difference is credited once as a savings true-up, returned as the plan's true-up method provides: an invoice credit. Each allocation year is trued up only once.

## Measuring the year

- **Allocation year.** One allocation year runs from an anniversary of the allocation date through the day before the next anniversary.
- **Which lines fall in the year.** Subscription fee lines are placed in an allocation year by their billing period start, the first day of the utility cycle whose credit they invoice.
- **The year's credits.** The total of the bill credit values on those fee lines.
- **The year's fees.** The total of the amounts of those fee lines.
- **Guaranteed ceiling.** The year's credits multiplied by 100 less the plan's discount percentage, divided by 100.
- **True-up.** The year's fees less the guaranteed ceiling, credited as a savings true-up line that records the first day of the allocation year checked.
- **Once per year.** Whether an allocation year has already been trued up is judged from the system record: a savings true-up line on that subscription for that allocation year's first day.

## Worked year (hypothetical inputs)

Hypothetical allocation year with bill credits totalling $1,000.00 on a plan discount of 10.0%:

| Year's fees | Guaranteed ceiling | Fees exceed the ceiling? | Savings true-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| $905.40 | $900.00 | Yes, by $5.40 | Credit of $5.40 |
| $900.00 | $900.00 | No, equal | None arises under this clause |
| $893.10 | $900.00 | No | None arises under this clause |

## Points of reading

- The comparison is made for the allocation year that ends at the anniversary, not for a calendar year.
- The difference is credited once; a year that already carries a savings true-up line is not trued up again.
